value.rationale: Erlang stage number is a natural smooth memory-kernel complexity and variance parameter, not an arbitrary numerical slice. A rigorously proved first shape-universal stability restoration at stage five, with closed-form thresholds for all positive-feedback center coefficients, distinguishes stabilization by distributed smoothing from Dirac-delay switching. This natural finite exact cutoff informs delay-filter model choice without a paper-sized general theorem.
